newsitem.title: INDIA: Net issue of ad hocs below agreed limits - India RBI.
newsitem.headline: Net issue of ad hocs below agreed limits - India RBI.

text.p: The net issue of ad hoc treasury bills to raise funds for the government was 33.6 billion rupees on October 4 over the March 31, 1996 level, the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said on Monday.
This was below the "within the year" and "year-end" ceiling of 90 billion and 50 billion rupees respectively agreed upon between the RBI and the government, an RBI statement said.
It said the net issue of ad hoc treasury bills has been "within the year" ceiling since August 14, 1996.

On many occasions, the net issue has been below the "year-end" ceiling. On September 20, the net issue was as low as 3.25 billion rupees and, during the period September 21 to 28, the outstanding level of ad hoc bills declined, it said.
